Use this endpoint to match org chart information based on [input values](#751a9156-1867-4033-a115-a44aa0ecbfad) and return the desired [output fields](#b2c219d2-df68-4ccd-9914-c7c58218f768) in the response.

**Input params**

| Parameter | DataType | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| companyId | String | Required. The id of the company for which you want to view the org chart hierarchy |

Returns a list of fields you can specify as output for the [Org Chart Enrich](#763b3c10-41d1-4d52-9775-1712f712202e) endpoint.
